name: organizations
title: Organizations & Teams
description: Multi-tenant organizations with owner/admin/member roles and email invitations
notes: Users manage teams under the new "Organizations" sidebar item (/orgs).
Invitations are emailed links to /invite?token=… and expire after 7 days.
Scope your own routes with `requireOrgRole('admin')` and `getOrg(res)` from src/modules/organizations (path param `:org` = id or slug).
